bagPolicy.summary: The official Coliseum athletics guide allows one clear bag up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches or one gallon, plus a clutch up to 4.5 × 6.5 inches. Backpacks, including clear ones, are prohibited; confirm the concert’s own policy.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: For gymnastics events, E-lots including Joe Craft Center, Linden Walk, Alumni Career Center and High Street open three hours before the meet. Concert parking locations and hours are not specified.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue has not published a specific concert rideshare pickup or drop-off point in the official Coliseum event guide.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Aramark provides athletics concessions on the Lexington Avenue and Rose Street concourses, including grab-and-go options. The Coliseum accepts Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover and is not cashless.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible concourse-level seating is available, and the athletics guide directs guests to call the UK Ticket Office at 859-257-1818 in advance. Accessible parking is north of Joe Craft Center with a valid placard.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The official athletics event guide states that re-entry is not allowed at the Coliseum on the same ticket; it does not publish a concert-specific exception.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: For gymnastics events, guests collecting will-call tickets use the Lexington Avenue entrance and follow signs. A concert pickup time is not specified.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: For gymnastics, the guide lists entrances at Lexington Avenue, Rose Street and Avenue of Champions/Euclid Avenue, with doors one hour before the meet. Concert door times are not specified.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
